rows.text: Exception tracking in acme worker: reportException() in services/worker/src/report.ts is a stub that only logs; the real tracker client is not wired because it is unknown which tracker Jordan uses. The render-pdf job now logs, reports and rethrows crashes (branch acme-388-render-pdf-crash-reporting, 4f2a9c1, not pushed).
Jordan's rule: no emojis in code, commit messages or docs (emojis were removed from services/worker/CHANGELOG.md).

acme-platform API rule: every table has an org_id column and every query must filter by org_id (req.auth.orgId); all route queries do. Invoice stats query was fixed for this. API JSON uses camelCase field names (e.g. totalCents) and SUM() results must be converted from DECIMAL strings to numbers.

acme infra is Terraform 1.8 in infra/terraform (aws provider ~> 5.60); the Pulumi stack was removed on 2026-08-26 (e40a7b9). Changes go through the CI plan/apply workflow, not applied locally. Buckets follow the pattern in s3.tf (acme-${var.env}-..., public access block, local.tags). Invoice exports bucket is infra/terraform/s3_invoice_exports.tf: private, objects expire after 90 days.
Public API rate limiting: apps/api/src/plugins/rate-limit.ts uses @fastify/rate-limit, 100 requests per minute per client IP, counted in Redis so all replicas share it, with /healthz exempt.
Jordan's preference: use the gh CLI for GitHub operations (issues, PRs). Issue #1318 tracks rollout of the invoice-exports S3 bucket.

Outgoing acme webhooks are signed with HMAC SHA-256 in the X-Acme-Signature header, format t=<timestamp>,v1=<hex> over '<timestamp>.<raw body>' (apps/api/src/webhooks/sign.ts). The dashboard webhooks settings page (apps/web/pages/settings/webhooks.tsx) was corrected from the wrong X-Signature/SHA-1 text.

The acme CLI reads its config (including webhookSecret) from ~/.acme/config.json, not from environment variables; `acme webhooks test` uses readConfig() and errors if webhookSecret is missing (set via `acme config set webhookSecret`). The web app is Next.js 13.5.6 with the pages router.

The worker image job (services/worker/src/jobs/processImage.ts) resizes uploads to thumb 160px, medium 640px and large 1600px wide (no upscaling), auto-rotates by EXIF, and writes WebP (quality 82) next to the original at <key>/<size>.webp; the original is kept. HEIC uploads (iPhone photos) fail in sharp; suggested fix is converting on the client or rejecting at POST /v1/uploads.

Running web e2e in acme-platform: start the dev server on port 3000 first (pnpm --filter web dev), then `pnpm --filter web e2e` (Playwright, optionally e2e/invoices). Known failure: invoices/detail.spec.ts 'downloads pdf' 404s because the seed invoice inv_e2e_1 has no pdfKey (fixture gap, also failing in nightly staging e2e); seeding a pdfKey was offered but not done.

Web auth provider in acme is Auth0 via @auth0/nextjs-auth0 (pages/api/auth/[auth0].ts, lib/session.ts, docs/architecture.md). next-auth in apps/web/package.json is an unused leftover from a Nov 2025 spike (0aa31f2); removing it was deferred ('later').

Open zod bump: deps-bot PR #1312 (zod 3.23.8 to 3.24.1, branch deps/zod-3.24.1). Five type errors from stricter inference were fixed and committed locally as a8c4f31 but not pushed; deps-bot will rebase and re-request CI once pushed.

Bug pattern found in acme web: setLoading(true)/setSubmitting(true) followed by an early return without resetting state leaves buttons spinning (fixed in ExportButton using try/finally). Two more unfixed instances: components/clients/ArchiveClientButton.tsx:18 (409 response) and components/settings/InviteMemberForm.tsx:31 (validation failure).

Added utilities/flags: parsePaymentTerms() in apps/api/src/lib/payment-terms.ts (net N for 1-365, 'due on receipt' = 0, throws InvalidPaymentTermsError otherwise; reviewer suggested optionally accepting a trailing 'days'), and `acme invoices list --json` which prints the raw array as pretty JSON for piping to jq.

ADR 0009 (accepted 2026-03-18): the acme web app does not use Redux. Server state stays in TanStack Query; small client state uses zustand stores colocated with the feature (e.g. useInvoiceEditorStore). Lena wanted Redux for the invoice editor; zustand is the answer.

Gotcha (docs/gotchas.md): Clerk dev keys (pk_test_) fail production builds, and preview deploys build with NODE_ENV=production, so they need the live publishable key. .github/workflows/preview.yml:41 wrongly passes CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY_DEV, causing 'Clerk: production build detected with development keys' on preview (seen on PR #4866 acme-412-invoice-editor-store). Fixing it needs platform team approval since it is under .github/.

Jordan's rule: icon-only buttons must always have an aria-label (and icon aria-hidden). UI conventions in acme web: use shadcn/ui components from apps/web/components/ui and lucide-react icons, not the hand-rolled icons. Other icon-only buttons in components/ still lack labels (sweep offered, deferred).

Branch acme-412-invoice-editor-store (zustand invoice editor store, with duplicateLine action and shadcn buttons) is pushed but no PR is opened yet; duplicateLine has no test, and the LineItemRow grid's last column (2.5rem) is too narrow for two icon buttons.

TypeScript path aliases in acme-platform: @acme/* maps to packages/*/src (tsconfig.base.json); use @acme/shared/... instead of deep relative imports like ../../../../packages/shared/src. The worker depends on @acme/shared as workspace:* so its tsup build resolves it.

acme CLI exit-code convention: exit 2 for usage errors (throw UsageError), exit 1 for runtime errors (EXIT_USAGE/EXIT_RUNTIME in packages/cli/src/lib/errors.ts, mapped in index.ts). Bad args should print a one-line message, not a stack trace.

Jordan's standing rules: keep components small (under 150 lines) with colocated tests (the 400-line invoice editor will be split later), and before saying something is done, re-check the work for bugs and security issues.
All packages in acme-platform are ESM: every package.json has "type": "module", so no require() anywhere; use import.

Rule: keep secrets and tokens out of logs and error messages (a bearer token once showed up in an error log). The api logger (apps/api/src/lib/logger.ts, pino) now redacts auth headers, cookies and password/token/secret/apiKey fields, and scrubMessage() strips Bearer tokens from free-text messages.

API request ids: apps/api request-id middleware takes the x-request-id header (or generates a UUID), puts it on every request log as requestId and echoes it on the response. As of 2026-09-03 the web app never sends x-request-id and the error handler does not tag Sentry with it, so API logs cannot be lined up with web requests when debugging Sentry issues; proposed fix (add header to web fetch client, Sentry.setTag('requestId')) was not yet approved.

The acme-platform API was migrated from Express 4 to Fastify 5 (PR #412 by Marco, api 3.0.0). Middleware are now Fastify plugins in apps/api/src/plugins/ (auth, cors, rate-limit, request-id, error-handler), route handlers take (request, reply), tests use app.inject(). Express, body-parser and express-rate-limit are gone.
Search in acme-platform uses Postgres tsvector columns (see apps/api/drizzle/0031_clients_search.sql and db/schema/clients.ts), not Elasticsearch; do not pull in any search service.
Preference: if a fix is uncertain, say so plainly instead of guessing; the user lost an hour to a confident wrong guess.

Worker retry policy (services/worker/src/queue/retry.ts, shared by every consumer): maxRetries 3 with exponential backoff starting at 1s (1s, 2s, 4s), then the message goes to the dead-letter queue (DLQ). Worker acks after the write, not before.

Gotcha: on Windows the CLI config path broke because paths were built from process.env.HOME with hard-coded '/'. Always use path.join and os.homedir() for anything under the home directory (fixed in packages/cli config.ts and cache.ts, ~/.acme/config.json). The fix was not tested on a real Windows machine.

Money in acme-platform: API unit prices are integer cents and invoice line quantity can be fractional (hours like 2.5), so round each line to whole cents before summing. apps/web formatMoney(cents, currency) takes cents and uses Intl.NumberFormat (fixed the $1,204.3000000002 float noise).

Infra: AWS single provider in infra/terraform/providers.tf, region us-east-1 for everything (app, data, backups, state bucket); do not add provider aliases for other regions without talking to platform. S3 buckets follow acme-${var.env}-<name> with public access blocked and KMS (aws:kms) encryption; default tags team/env. Terraform v1.8.5.
Preference: shorter answers; the user does not want basics explained (e.g. terraform basics).
Plan: Priya will create the S3 bucket for monthly invoice export zips herself; the bucket work was parked and Claude should not draft it unless asked.

Invoice numbers (format INV-0042) come from a per-org counter table invoice_counters (migration apps/api/drizzle/0034_invoice_counters.sql); nextInvoiceNumber(tx, orgId) does an atomic upsert and must be called inside the same transaction that inserts the invoice. Fixes number collisions under parallel API tests. Drizzle migrations were at 0034.

CLI (@acme/cli, packages/cli, binary 'acme') is built with commander (replaced yargs in #409): each command group exports registerX(program) and subcommands register next to each other (e.g. commands/invoices/index.ts registers list and export). ESM, bundled with tsup to dist/index.js. TypeScript is strict with noUncheckedIndexedAccess (tsconfig.base.json, NodeNext), so indexing returns T | undefined and needs a check.
Rule for CLI commands: throw UsageError (exit code 2) for bad flags instead of calling process.exit inside handlers (pattern in commands/config.ts); errors otherwise print the message and exit 1.
A user-facing CLI change needs a changeset (release tooling) before the PR.

Command `acme invoices export --format csv|json --out <file> [--status]` was implemented in packages/cli/src/commands/invoices/export.ts and pushed on branch acme-240-invoices-export (commit 7e31b05) on 2026-09-07; no PR opened yet and a changeset is still needed.

Avatars are served from the CDN cdn.acme.dev (Lena moved them); apps/web/next.config.ts images.remotePatterns allows img.clerk.com and cdn.acme.dev. Any new remote image host must be added to remotePatterns, and config changes need a dev-server restart.

trailmix is Jordan's Django + htmx side project (~/code/trailmix). htmx POSTs need the CSRF token: base.html has <body hx-headers='{"X-CSRFToken": "{{ csrf_token }}"}'>. Models: Hike (user, name, date) and Segment (hike, order, elevation_delta_m); hike list view annotates elevation_gain_m via Sum with filter positive deltas. Its tests use the Django test client, which skips CSRF checks, so CSRF fixes need a manual browser check.

Gotcha for date tests in apps/web: mixing UTC dates (toISOString) with local-time dates caused a flaky invoice-status test (failed ~1 in 5 on CI, 11/50 under America/Los_Angeles). Components take an optional `now` prop and tests pass a fixed date; verify under several TZ values (UTC, America/Toronto, Asia/Tokyo). Date-only due dates are compared as UTC calendar days in apps/web/lib/due-label.ts.

Preference: invoice numbers and amounts in tables use a monospace font with tabular-nums (JetBrains Mono, set as Tailwind --font-mono in apps/web/app/globals.css via Google Fonts import) so digits do not jump; loading typefaces via CSS @import was flagged as possibly not matching the app's existing font setup.

Drizzle gotcha: relation loading must be explicit via `with:` (db.query.X.findMany) or you get N+1 loops. The orders list (apps/api/src/routes/orders/list.ts) was fixed from 101 queries / 1874ms to 1 query / 61ms for 50 orders. A reviewer found the same per-row loop in routes/payments/list.ts (payment attempts) and routes/clients/list.ts (contacts); a follow-up ticket was suggested and not done.

Plan: add `--since <date>` to `acme invoices export` for finance (API supports ?since=YYYY-MM-DD). Done: ListInvoicesParams.since in packages/cli/src/api.ts and parseSince (packages/cli/src/parse-since.ts, throws UsageError) with tests. Remaining: declare the --since option on the export subcommand and pass parseSince(opts.since) to listInvoices.

Rule: do not bump major versions of dependencies without asking the user first, even if CI is green. Patch/minor deps-bot PRs with green CI were approved and squash auto-merged on request; they still need a CODEOWNERS approval.

Open decision: deps-bot PR #426 bumps zod 3.23.8 -> 4.1.5 (major); typecheck and api tests fail, 37 call sites in apps/api and packages/cli are affected (z.string().email() deprecation, changed error map API). Left alone pending the user's call.

Why Drizzle instead of Prisma (ADR 0009, accepted 2026-05-12, docs/adr/0009-orm.md): Prisma's query engine made cold starts 3-4 s on new pods and job runners, slowing scale-out under bursts; Drizzle has no engine and cold start dropped to ~400 ms. Trade-offs: no Prisma Studio (use psql or TablePlus) and explicit relation loading (watch N+1).

Secrets in k8s come from AWS Secrets Manager via External Secrets Operator. The api Helm chart (infra/helm/api/templates/externalsecret.yaml) only pulls keys listed under `secrets:` in infra/helm/api/values-prod.yaml (and staging values), with secretsPrefix prod/api (refresh 1h). A new env secret must be added to that list, then ESO sync (or force-sync) and a pod restart. infra/ changes need Priya's review as CODEOWNER.

Open: POSTHOG_API_KEY is missing in prod api pods because it is not in the `secrets:` list of infra/helm/api/values-prod.yaml; fix (add `- name: POSTHOG_API_KEY` there and in staging, deploy, restart pods) was proposed on 2026-09-08 but not made yet. Priya reported it.

CI problem (as of 2026-09-08): .github/workflows/ci.yml runs lint, typecheck, build and test on the whole repo for every PR; only the pnpm store is cached. Median 13m52s (install 1m05, lint 21s, typecheck 1m48, build 3m31, test 6m49; api tests 3m40s with Testcontainers); 12 of 20 runs touched only one app or docs. User wants affected-only runs (e.g. pnpm --filter "...[origin/main]" with fetch-depth 0) plus reused build/test results between runs; asked whether an orchestration layer for caching already exists in the repo before rewriting. Deferred ('come back to that').
Ops note: api pod api-7c9f8d-x2kq was OOMKilled (512Mi limit) during the nightly export job on 2026-09-08, the second time that week; no user impact.

scripts/stale-branches.ts (run: pnpm tsx scripts/stale-branches.ts [--days 60] [--remote origin]) lists remote branches with no commits in N days with author and date; read-only, never deletes. Reviewer suggests validating --days (NaN lists nothing). Uncommitted as of 2026-09-08.

Transactional email in acme-platform is sent through Resend (apps/api/src/lib/mailer.ts, RESEND_API_KEY) and templates are React Email components in apps/api/emails (invoice-sent, receipt, welcome, payment-failed) using shared components/layout, button, footer. Templates export PreviewProps; reviewer asks for a SUBJECT constant per template as in invoice-sent.tsx.

Dunning work in progress (2026-09-08): apps/api/emails/payment-failed.tsx (invoice number, amount, card last 4, Retry payment button to hosted invoice URL) is written but not hooked into mailer.ts or the dunning job; the user wants to review where it fires since it is billing flow. SUBJECT export still to add.

acme-platform's primary database is Postgres 16 since ADR 0014 (accepted 2026-09-08, owner Marco Bianchi); MySQL 8 is retired. Local dev uses the postgres:16.4 image (port 5432, user/password/db all 'acme') and redis:7.2 (6379) from docker-compose.yml; DATABASE_URL must be postgres://user:pass@host:5432/acme; migrations restart from apps/api/drizzle/0031_pg_baseline.sql; Drizzle dialect is postgresql.
Jordan's rule for acme-platform: no console.log in committed code; use the pino logger (req.log / request.log in the api, shared logger in the worker). Never log whole request bodies.

Only env vars prefixed NEXT_PUBLIC_ are exposed to the browser in apps/web, so never put secrets in them; a Stripe NEXT_PUBLIC_ var must be the publishable pk_ key, secret sk_ keys belong to the api only. apps/web/.env.example had NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_KEY=sk_test_replace_me (added by Lena Fischer) which was flagged but not yet renamed.

To run the acme worker locally: start redis (docker compose up -d redis) then run `pnpm --filter worker dev` (tsx watch); it consumes the reminders, images and exports queues and serves metrics on port 9464.
Lena Fischer is a teammate on acme-platform who works on the web app and reviews PRs (e.g. #479, #482); she also tries the internal CLI on her own machine (a Linux box with pyenv).

Marco Bianchi owns the Postgres migration (ADR 0014) and added the orgs.callback_url column to the schema in early September 2026. Priya Shah leads the platform team: owns infra/ and DNS (CODEOWNERS approval needed) and grants the eng-prod-readers Tailscale group for prod db access.

formatMoney in apps/web/lib/money.ts rounds on the decimal string (Number(`${amount}e2`)) because Math.round(amount*100) turned 2.005 into 2.00 (float error); tests in money.test.ts cover 2.005, credit notes and fr-CA. Most callers pass cents/100, so the proper long-term fix is formatting from integer cents. Intl roundingMode does not fix binary-float inputs.

The internal CLI is published to npm as the restricted package @acme/cli (0.9.3 latest, 0.10.0-next.2 on 'next' tag); install with `npm install -g @acme/cli`, binary is `acme` (acme login, acme --help). Users need to be logged in to npm with their org account. package.json declares engines node >=18.
Jordan's rule: always run the full test suite (`pnpm test`, turbo across all 5 packages) before pushing, not just the changed tests; he got burned by skipping it.
trailmix is Jordan's separate side project: a Django app (hikes app with Trail and Hike models) with htmx-driven templates, at /Users/jordan/code/trailmix. It is unrelated to the acme-platform work.

In acme web, InvoiceStatusBadge takes prop `status` (draft|sent|paid|overdue|void; renamed from `kind`) and `size` ('sm'|'md', default md; table row passes sm when dense). Separately, invoice.kind means one-off vs recurring. Badge labels are translated via next-intl.

Playwright e2e gotcha in apps/web: never read rows once with allTextContents() right after a click (server refetch makes it flaky ~1 in 5); use retrying assertions like expect(locator).toHaveText([...]) and check aria-sort. Fixed this way in e2e/invoices/sort.spec.ts (30/30 with --repeat-each=15).

UI copy conventions for acme web: product says no exclamation marks in empty states; use the label "New invoice" on every create-invoice button (not "Create invoice"). Agreed in review of PR #479 by Lena Fischer.

PR #479 (new invoices empty state, branch acme-447-invoices-empty-state) still needs rendering tests for empty/error/loading before merge, per Lena Fischer; error state must take priority over empty state.

Lena Fischer suggested eventually moving all empty states to a shared EmptyState primitive in packages/ui; deliberately a separate effort, not part of PR #479. The invoices one is InvoicesEmptyState in components/invoices/empty-state.tsx with overridable title/body/CTA, reusable on the clients page.
Storybook for acme web runs on port 6006 via `pnpm --filter web storybook` (Storybook 8.3.5, nextjs); stories live next to components, e.g. Invoices/StatusBadge with Sizes and SmallAllStatuses.

Product analytics in acme web use PostHog through the track() wrapper in apps/web/lib/analytics.ts (posthog.capture); events must be added to the AnalyticsEvent union. Tracked: invoice_created, invoice_sent, revenue_range_changed. Status filter clicks are NOT tracked (Sam asked 2026-09-11; suggested invoice_status_filter_changed).

trailmix gotcha: Django auto_now on Hike.updated_at does not fire on QuerySet.update() or bulk_update(); fix suggested is a custom HikeQuerySet overriding update() to set updated_at (bulk_update needs updated_at in its fields); only a Postgres trigger catches raw SQL.

acme web i18n uses next-intl: messages in apps/web/messages/{en,fr,es}.json loaded per locale by i18n/request.ts; every new UI string needs keys in all three. The es strings for invoices.status were written by Claude and should be checked by a Spanish speaker. Known gaps: es.json missing settings.billing.portalLink/portalHint; fr.json has stale invoices.filters.archived.

Worker job `events.invoice-paid` (services/worker/src/jobs/deliver-invoice-paid.ts) POSTs an invoice.paid JSON event to orgs.callback_url with a 10s timeout and throws on non-2xx so the queue retries. Still TODO: the enqueue call in the api payment-succeeded handler (billing code, Jordan to do/review) and tests for the job (missing callback URL, non-2xx, timeout).

DNS for acme is on Cloudflare, one zone acme.dev. Records are declared in infra/dns/records.yaml and applied by the dns-sync workflow (plan on PR, apply on merge); never edit in the Cloudflare dashboard (sync reverts it). Proxied is default; proxied:false for raw TLS passthrough. infra/ is Priya Shah's platform team in CODEOWNERS.

Plan: host a webhook test receiver at hooks-test.acme.dev so customers can see sample invoice.paid deliveries; needs one CNAME in infra/dns/records.yaml (Priya's approval) once the receiver service exists and has a load balancer target. Nothing changed yet.

Invoice PDF download filenames (apps/api/src/invoices/pdf-filename.ts) are now slug-style like inv-1042_bright-pixel-studio.pdf (accents stripped, client part capped at 60 chars). apps/api/src/exports/csv-filename.ts still builds 'Export <org> <date>.csv' with spaces/slashes; recommendation is a shared slugify util used there too.
Timestamps in acme-platform are stored in UTC; convert to local time only in the UI (next-intl useFormatter with the user's timeZone from providers.tsx); no timezone math in the api.

The acme CLI uses picocolors for terminal color, not chalk. Known issue: ui/table.ts pads with String.length so ANSI codes misalign columns under FORCE_COLOR; planned fix is padding on visible width (strip ANSI).

As of 2026-09-14, branch feat/invoices-paid-at-column holds only the web 'paid at' column commit (7e3b2d4, separate ticket, unpushed); the pdf filename change, CLI status colors and later work (null-client fix, void confirm, etc.) are uncommitted in the working tree. Reviewer suggested columns tests for null paidAt and a non-Toronto time zone.

Imported invoices in acme can have no client: InvoiceRow.client is now typed ClientSummary | null in apps/web/lib/api/types.ts, and UI falls back to a 'No client' label (invoices.noClient message key). Always null-check invoice.client.
Unit tests across all acme-platform packages use vitest (with @testing-library/react in web); do not pull in jest or jest-dom, use plain assertions like toBeTruthy/toBeNull.

Interactive prompts in the acme CLI use @clack/prompts; destructive commands need a confirmation that is skippable with -y/--yes, defaulting to No, and refuse (exit code 2) in a non-TTY shell without --yes. `invoices void` confirms with 'Void INV-1042 ($2,400.00 CAD) for Northwind Agency?'. No tests yet for the prompt path or non-TTY refusal.

acme web sends security headers on every route from apps/web/next.config.ts headers(): CSP (frame-ancestors 'none'), X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff, strict-origin-when-cross-origin referrer, HSTS 2 years with preload, Permissions-Policy denying camera/mic/geolocation. Caveat: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline' (nonces would be a bigger change). Verified live on app.acme.dev 2026-09-14.

CLI startup runtime check (packages/cli/src/lib/runtime-check.ts) warns in yellow and exits 1 when the runtime major version is below MIN_MAJOR=20, which was a guess; package.json engines says node >=18, so the real supported minimum must be confirmed and the two aligned. Support ticket from a client agency (CLI crashes after install) is awaiting their error output; reply draft left generic on package name.

Jordan switched from Docker Desktop to OrbStack (around 2026-09-07); local containers run on OrbStack, docker context 'orbstack' is now active (old desktop-linux context still exists). The OrbStack Postgres volume started empty, so local migrations had to be re-run.

Prod database access (docs/runbooks/prod-db-access.md, current after the Postgres move): only via Tailscale (no public endpoint). Be in the eng-prod-readers ACL group (ask Priya Shah), `tailscale up` and confirm prod-subnet-router is online, get read-only creds from AWS Secrets Manager `prod/db/readonly`, psql to acme-prod.cluster-ro.internal:5432 database acme (RDS reader endpoint; no separate analytics replica). Put your name in application_name; sessions are logged; writes only via migrations.

acme CLI `invoices list --json` prints a pretty-printed JSON array of items (no color); decision: array is fine while --limit bounds output, and if an --all paging mode is ever added, add a separate --jsonl flag rather than changing --json.
Acme CLI telemetry is opt-out: users disable it with ACME_TELEMETRY=0, and `acme status` prints whether telemetry is on or off (telemetryEnabled() in packages/cli/src/telemetry.ts).
Acme has moved off RabbitMQ: the worker consumes BullMQ queues on Redis 7. Bull Board is mounted at /admin/queues on the worker behind basic auth; link that instead of the RabbitMQ management UI.
Acme CI runs on GitHub Actions: workflows are in .github/workflows/ci.yml, and prod deploys go out from git tags v* via release.yml. A normal release run takes about 12 minutes.

Gotcha: release.yml build-images once took 41 minutes because the buildx cache ref was renamed from :buildcache to :main (commit 8c1f2d0) but cache-to still writes :buildcache, so cache-from missed and all layers rebuilt. The user said they would fix the cache ref themselves; cache-from and cache-to must use the same ref (release.yml lines 41-52).

Convention: marketing pages in apps/web/app/(marketing) use ISR with `export const revalidate = 60`. The blog/[slug] route is at 3600 and left as is; about and legal/terms are static with no revalidate export.
Gotcha: the Checkbox in apps/web components/ui is the Radix one (a button, not an input), so use onCheckedChange (true | false | 'indeterminate') rather than onChange.

The user has a side project called trailmix at /Users/jordan/code/trailmix: a Django app with htmx (hikes app with Hike, Trail, Region, Tag models). It is separate from acme-platform; view hike_create returns the _form.html partial for HX-Request.
Rule in acme-platform: apply DB migrations with `pnpm --filter api db:migrate` (drizzle-kit).
Rule in acme-platform: list endpoints use cursor pagination (opaque cursor on created_at + id), never offset pagination.
Rule in acme-platform: money is stored as integer cents (e.g. amount_cents bigint), never floats.

Payments architecture (docs/architecture/payments.md, read it before payment work): checkout uses Stripe Checkout in redirect mode and the web app never sees card data; Stripe calls POST /v1/webhooks/stripe, events are stored idempotently in stripe_events and a job updates invoice status; the payout.paid webhook creates payouts rows, shown under Settings > Payouts. Open question: backfilling payouts created before the connected-account migration.
Ticket acme-238 is the payouts list endpoint (GET /v1/payouts, cursor-paginated by (created_at, id), table payouts from migration 0044). It was merged to main as PR #418.
